scientific.integrity: The radius and the forced majority-center orbit are proved analytically for every odd order at least three, with exact cutpoint verification needed to upgrade from vertex coverage to full-polygon coverage. The closest even-family theorem, general two-center algorithms, and regular-polygon numerical covering sources are compared by implication. Standalone symbolic and finite checks are supplementary.
limitations: Only regular odd planar polygons; neither even polygons nor irregular polygons.
The complementary optimal disk center is not fully classified.
Historical exact formulas in unindexed sources remain possible.

title: Exact two-disk covering radius of every regular odd polygon
